title: HPE Unveils The First Of The Next Generation of ProLiants for the AI Era
gist: HPE unveiled the first four ProLiant Gen 13 servers, all built on AMD's 6th Gen Epyc 'Venice' CPUs, aimed at enterprise inference and agentic AI with new iLO 8 security features. HPE's Carter expects the CPU-to-GPU ratio in agentic workloads to move from 2-to-8 CPUs per GPU toward one to one, while Bain warns AI infrastructure spending could reach $1.5 trillion by 2031.

insights.claim: Bain & Co predicts annual AI infrastructure spending could hit $1.5 trillion by 2031, with power capacity in the most advanced AI datacenters nearing 1 GW and potentially doubling by next year and passing 9 GW by the end of the decade.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Sizing for the multi-year capex wave that server OEMs target.

insights.claim: Bain says capital spending from Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Oracle and Meta is expected to reach $780 billion this year, about five times the amount from three years ago.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Hyperscaler capex has grown roughly 5x in three years.

insights.claim: Bain cautions that the more important question may be whether enough economic value can be created to justify the AI buildout.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Return on investment is the open risk to the buildout.
insights.quote: But the more important question may be whether enough economic value can be created to justify it.

insights.claim: HPE unveiled the first four ProLiant Gen 13 systems, all using AMD's 6th Gen Epyc 9006 SP7 'Venice' CPUs released in July, aimed at dense computing and GPU workloads for enterprise AI inferencing and agentic AI.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: HPE is tied to AMD CPUs for its new generation, a win for Epyc in enterprise AI servers.

insights.claim: The ProLiant DL585a is a 10U server holding up to eight double-wide GPUs from Nvidia, AMD or Intel and two Epyc CPUs with up to 256 cores each, with PCIe 6, available March 2027 and kept air-cooled for enterprises and mid-tier service providers.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: A GPU-agnostic air-cooled box targets customers limited by power rather than space.

insights.claim: The ProLiant DL525 is a single-socket 1U air-cooled system with a 256-core AMD chip, 16-channel memory and DDR5 or MRDIMM support, available next month for AI inference, EDA and fraud detection.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: The first Gen 13 box to ship is a CPU-centric platform.

insights.claim: Two XD systems due next year, the XD245 (four half-width dual-socket nodes, liquid-cooled) and XD285 (two nodes, air-cooled), use a 2OU chassis in an open 21-inch ORV3 rack with shared power and cooling for maximum compute density.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: HPE is adopting open-rack designs for density-focused customers.

themes.theme: Agentic AI shifts demand to CPUs

insights.claim: HPE's John Carter says customers running PCIe GPUs are running out of power long before they run out of space, motivating the larger air-cooled DL585a.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Power, not rack space, is the binding constraint for enterprise GPU deployment.

insights.claim: HPE expects agentic AI to shift CPU-to-GPU ratios from two to eight CPUs per GPU toward roughly one to one, requiring dense CPU platforms to offload agent actions.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Agentic workloads could expand CPU server demand, benefiting AMD and Intel server CPUs.
insights.quote: Now we're shifting from GPU-focus to CPU-focus

insights.claim: iLO 8 adds self-encrypting storage drives that encrypt and decrypt from boot, multi-party authorization requiring two human approvers for high-impact actions by AI or agents such as key provisioning and secure erase, and expanded post-quantum cryptography against 'harvest now, decrypt later' attacks.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Security features are being positioned as differentiators for agentic AI deployments.
